insight: Qatar's performance in the 2026 World Cup has shown a notable impact from hydration breaks, with the team gaining momentum in 5 out of 6 breaks, indicating a slight increase in their scoring chances per minute after the break. This suggests that the team is able to regroup and refocus during these stops, coming back onto the field with renewed energy and intensity. When Qatar was pressing before a hydration break, they struggled to maintain their momentum, actually losing ground with a decrease in scoring chances per minute, but when they weren't pressing, they were able to capitalize on the break and come out stronger. Overall, the data implies that hydration breaks have been a beneficial strategic element for Qatar, allowing them to adjust their approach and gain an edge over their opponents.
